fato_historico: 1982: The Salang Tunnel fire in Afghanistan kills 150–2000 people.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a reflective energy where you may feel a deep call to cherish the warmth of human connection. Just as light seeks to overcome the shadows of the past, consider how your own inner fire can guide others. It is a good time to shine brightly, practice compassion, and offer hope to those walking through darker paths.
frase_do_dia: Your courage is a beacon that leads the way toward brighter, luckier horizons.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual wisdom and the path toward finding your personal truth.
conselho: Focus on radiating kindness and keep your spirit lifted through every challenge today.
